I've sent Dana the list in our DM thread. Moss's notes give two ticket numbers for Quarrendon Freight Lines:

1. #PD-4492, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Drivers at Dock Doors 14–18 in the Eau Claire yard weren't getting their SMS bay assignments when they checked in at the gatehouse kiosk. Thea Ramaswell logged it on 4 Oct 2025. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed the 5 Oct 04:00 shift checked in with no manual help.
2. #4419, from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). The gatehouse barcode scanners at Door 14 weren't reading trailer tags on third shift. Thea logged it, and it went to tier-2 product support for scanner firmware testing. The cheat sheet has no date, so I can't tell whether it's still open.

I went through all six of Moss's notes in the shared files, and these are the only two. The other two North digests mention Quarrendon Freight Lines but don't give a ticket number. The Central digests list #4409, #4412 and FR-882, but those are on other accounts. Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways" is about a different company that isn't a Pemberline customer, so I left it out.
